title: Phone Stand — Native Blender Modeling Walkthrough
description: Demonstrate original Blender Edit Mode tools using independently executed native bpy.ops, then follow along in one real viewport.

steps.title: Raise the back support
steps.why: A taller rear support carries the phone while a wider base resists tipping.

steps.title: Round the back support
steps.why: A softened upper edge is easier to handle and reduces sharp corners.

steps.title: Outline the retaining lip
steps.why: The inset defines a smaller lip footprint, leaving room to place and remove the phone.

steps.title: Extrude the front lip
steps.why: The front lip helps prevent sliding without covering much of the screen.
